negative_constraints: do not sit the hips back toward the heels

pose_mechanics: body lying on the back on the mat
knees bent and drawn toward the chest
feet lifted upward with soles facing the ceiling
hands holding the outer edges of the feet
critical_relations: knees bend outward toward the armpits
feet stack above the knees rather than forward
visibility_constraints: both feet and both hands holding them must remain clearly visible
negative_constraints: not knees-to-chest with arms wrapped around legs
do not extend the legs straight upward
do not place the feet on the floor

pose_mechanics: body lying flat on the back
both knees drawn inward toward the chest
arms wrapped around the shins or knees
head resting on the floor
critical_relations: knees move toward the torso rather than outward
arms hug the legs instead of holding the feet
visibility_constraints: both bent knees and arm wrap must remain clearly visible

pose_mechanics: body lying on the back
one knee bent and drawn across the body toward the opposite side
opposite shoulder remaining grounded
arms extended outward in a T shape
critical_relations: spine rotates while shoulders stay grounded
bent knee crosses the midline of the body
visibility_constraints: the twisted leg and open arm position must remain clearly visible
negative_constraints: do not keep the torso facing straight upward without rotation

view_hints.angled: show the crossed ankle resting clearly on the opposite thigh and both knees separated

pose_mechanics: body lying on the back
one ankle crosses over the opposite thigh just above the knee forming a clear figure-four
crossed knee opens outward to the side rather than pointing upward
support leg bends with the shin roughly vertical and the foot lifted off the floor
hands thread through to hold the back of the support thigh or shin
critical_relations: crossed ankle rests on the opposite thigh above the knee, not on the shin
support knee lifts toward the torso while the crossed knee stays open to the side
visibility_constraints: the full figure-four shape and both knees must remain clearly visible
negative_constraints: do not place the support foot on the floor
do not tangle or interlace the legs
do not pull the crossed knee across the midline
do not hide the crossed lower leg behind the support leg

pose_mechanics: legs extended straight forward together on the mat
feet flexed with toes pointing upward
torso upright stacked over the hips
hands placed on the floor beside the hips
critical_relations: spine remains vertical rather than leaning back
legs stay fully straight and together
visibility_constraints: both legs must remain fully visible from hips to feet
negative_constraints: not leaning back on straight arms
